name: resolve_in_workspace

test_list.description: Reject parent traversal, rooted paths, UNC and device prefixes before filesystem access.
Reject alternate data streams, reserved device names and trailing dot/space components.
Fail closed on symlink/junction components and canonical paths outside the workspace.
Deny .env, PEM/key files and .git/config without an approval fact.

inputs.name: root
inputs.description: Trusted workspace root selected by the composition root.

output_description: A workspace-contained path after lexical and filesystem containment checks, or a policy/input/I/O error. Component check/open remains subject to a documented OS race without handle-relative resolver support.
